First lets check to see what predictions need to be gapfilled. We'll do this by reading in the flag country predictions and comparing to the Rousseau data. If any effort is missing for a flag, we will run the predictions here for gapfilling. 

```{r}

 modelled_flags_original <- str_before_first(str_after_last(list.files(file.path(rdsi_dir, "prep/random_forest/predictions_industrial_flag_revised_floor_0/"), pattern = ".qs", full.names = TRUE), "_"), "\\.qs")

  all_files_flag <- list.files(file.path(rdsi_dir, "prep/random_forest/predictions_industrial_flag_revised_floor_depth/"), full.names = TRUE)

    all_data <- lapply(all_files_flag[-133], qread) %>%
      bind_rows()

all_data_grouped_2 <- all_data %>% 
  group_by(year, flag_country_iso3c, flag_country_name, gear, length_category) %>%
    summarise(modeled_eff_active_fishing_hours = sum(eff_active_fishing_hours, na.rm = TRUE), 
            modeled_eff_active_fishing_days = sum(eff_active_fishing_days, na.rm = TRUE), 
            modeled_nom_active_fishing_hours = sum(nom_active_fishing_hours, na.rm = TRUE), 
            modeled_nom_active_fishing_days = sum(nom_active_fishing_days, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
    mutate(flag_country_name = case_when(
          flag_country_iso3c == "RAM" ~ "Madeira",
          flag_country_iso3c == "RAA" ~ "Azores", 
          TRUE ~ flag_country_name
  ))

check_rousseau_data <- qs::qread(here("data/int/rousseau_gear_fix.qs")) %>%
    ## remove artisanal
    filter(sector == "I") %>%
    group_by(year, flag_fin = country, gear = gear_new, length_category) %>%
    summarize(
      total_nominal_fishing_hours = sum(nom_active_hours, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_effective_fishing_hours = sum(eff_active_hours, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_nominal_fishing_days = sum(nom_active, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_effective_fishing_days = sum(eff_active, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(flag_country_iso3c = flag_fin, year, gear, length_category, total_nominal_fishing_hours, total_effective_fishing_hours, total_nominal_fishing_days, total_effective_fishing_days) %>%
        filter(total_nominal_fishing_hours > 0) %>%
  mutate(flag_country_name = countrycode(flag_country_iso3c, origin = "iso3c", destination = "country.name")) %>%
  mutate(flag_country_name = case_when(
          flag_country_iso3c == "RAM" ~ "Madeira",
          flag_country_iso3c == "RAA" ~ "Azores", 
          TRUE ~ flag_country_name
  )) %>% 
  left_join(all_data_grouped_2) %>%
  mutate(modeled_eff_active_fishing_hours = ifelse(is.na(modeled_eff_active_fishing_hours), 0, modeled_eff_active_fishing_hours),
         modeled_eff_active_fishing_days = ifelse(is.na(modeled_eff_active_fishing_days), 0, modeled_eff_active_fishing_days), 
         modeled_nom_active_fishing_hours = ifelse(is.na(modeled_nom_active_fishing_hours), 0, modeled_nom_active_fishing_hours),
         modeled_nom_active_fishing_days = ifelse(is.na(modeled_nom_active_fishing_days), 0, modeled_nom_active_fishing_days)) %>%
  mutate(proportion_hours_modeled = modeled_nom_active_fishing_hours/total_nominal_fishing_hours)

missing_data <- check_rousseau_data %>%
  filter(proportion_hours_modeled != 1) %>%
  filter(proportion_hours_modeled < 0.9999)

flags_missing <- unique(missing_data$flag_country_iso3c) # 19 flags missing

regions_missing_df <- hist_fish_data %>% 
  filter(flag_fin %in% c(flags_missing)) %>%
  distinct(flag_fin, region)
  
regions_missing <- hist_fish_data %>% 
  filter(flag_fin %in% c(flags_missing)) %>%
  pull(region) %>%

years_missing <- unique(missing_data$year) # all years missing, because of DOM for example

regions_missing_df_2 <- hist_fish_data %>%
  filter(flag_fin %in% c(flags_missing)) %>%
  distinct(flag_fin, year)

## now read get sample size based flags that we need to fill. Any flag with <100 observations will be fully gapfilled, so we need to run those models here.

flags_missing_fin <- unique(c(flags_missing, sample_size_flags))

)
```

Reachability

```{r}
reach <- fread(here("data/int/reachability_regional_gf.csv"))

dist_eez <- fread(here("data/int/dist_from_home_eez.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-eez_id) %>%
  rename(flag_fin = eez_sovereign)
```


After the models are fit, we make predictions on ALL DATA. So stage 1 is in sample predictions (since we fit the stage one model on all data), and stage two will contain out of sample predictions (since we fit the model on only data with fishing effort in it!)

```{r}

years   <- 1950:2017
out_dir <- file.path(rdsi_dir, "prep/random_forest/predictions_regional/yearly")
s1_dir  <- file.path(rdsi_dir, "prep/random_forest/stage_1_models_regional")
s2_dir  <- file.path(rdsi_dir, "prep/random_forest/stage_2_models_regional")

n_workers <- 4
n_threads <- max(1, floor(parallel::detectCores() / n_workers))  # ranger threads per worker

## Safety checks:
## - dist_eez is joined once per flag, so it must not vary by year
## - env data must not contribute columns the lookup tables join on (env is joined last)
env_only    <- setdiff(names(env_data_fishing_areas), c("lon", "lat", "year", "pixel_id"))
lookup_cols <- unique(c(names(access_data_loop), names(access_data_high_seas_loop),
                        names(reach), names(dist_eez)))
stopifnot(!"year" %in% names(dist_eez))

## Spatial columns that live in the env data but are needed for the lookup joins
## (e.g. eez_sovereign). Take them once per cell and attach them to the grid.
env_spatial_cols <- intersect(env_only, c(lookup_cols, "eez_sovereign"))

env_static <- env_data_fishing_areas %>%
  distinct(lon, lat, across(all_of(env_spatial_cols)))

# these must be constant across years for each cell, otherwise they can't be joined once
stopifnot(nrow(env_static) == nrow(distinct(env_static, lon, lat)))

grid_with_spatial <- env_grid_fishing_areas %>%
  left_join(env_static, by = c("lon", "lat"))

reach_keys <- intersect(names(reach), c("flag_fin", "gear", "length_category"))

## Split big tables once so each iteration grabs its slice directly
env_by_year  <- split(env_data_fishing_areas, env_data_fishing_areas$year)
hist_by_flag <- split(hist_fish_data, hist_fish_data$flag_fin)

read_model <- function(dir, stage, region) {
  f <- list.files(dir, pattern = glue("stage_{stage}_rf_model_full_data_{region}_.*\\.qs$"),
                  full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(f) == 0) stop("No stage ", stage, " model found for region: ", region)
  qs::qread(f[1])
}

flags_finished <- unique(sub("^model_preds_(.+)_\\d{4}\\.qs$", "\\1",
                             list.files(out_dir, pattern = "^model_preds_.*\\.qs$")))
flags_to_run   <- sort(setdiff(flags_missing_fin, flags_finished))

## Fork cluster: workers share the parent's memory instead of each getting serialized copies
cl <- parallel::makeForkCluster(n_workers)
doParallel::registerDoParallel(cl)

res <- foreach(flag = flags_to_run, .errorhandling = "pass", .inorder = FALSE) %dopar% {

  # flag = "CUB"
  hist_flag <- hist_by_flag[[flag]]

  regional_name <- if (flag == "STP") "SubAfrica" else unique(hist_flag$region)

  stage2_model <- read_model(s2_dir, 2, regional_name)
  stage1_model <- read_model(s1_dir, 1, regional_name)

  cats_by_year <- distinct(hist_flag, year, flag_fin, gear, length_category)

  ## Largest radius any year allows per category -> loose spatial pre-filter
  max_radius <- reach %>%
    filter(!is.na(radius_km_med)) %>%
    { if ("flag_fin" %in% names(.)) filter(., flag_fin == flag) else . } %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(reach_keys))) %>%
    summarise(max_radius = max(radius_km_med), .groups = "drop")

  ## Year-invariant grid: built once per flag
 static_grid <- tidyr::crossing(grid_with_spatial,
                                 distinct(cats_by_year, flag_fin, gear, length_category)) %>%
    dplyr::select(-any_of("pixel_id")) %>%
    left_join(dist_eez) %>%
    inner_join(max_radius, by = reach_keys) %>%
    filter(dist_km <= max_radius) %>%        # loose pre-filter; exact per-year filter below
    dplyr::select(-max_radius)

  for (yr in years) {
    
    # yr = 2017

    out_file <- file.path(out_dir, glue("model_preds_{flag}_{yr}.qs"))
    # test <- qread(out_file)
    if (file.exists(out_file)) next

    env_yr  <- env_by_year[[as.character(yr)]]
    cats_yr <- filter(cats_by_year, year == yr)
    if (is.null(env_yr) || nrow(cats_yr) == 0) next

    full_data <- static_grid %>%
      semi_join(cats_yr, by = c("flag_fin", "gear", "length_category")) %>%
      mutate(year = yr) %>%
      left_join(access_data_loop) %>%
      left_join(access_data_high_seas_loop) %>%
      mutate(access     = ifelse(is.na(access), 0, access),
             access_fao = ifelse(is.na(access_fao), 0, access_fao),
             access     = ifelse(eez_sovereign == flag, 1, access),   # always allow fishing in own EEZ
             access_fin = ifelse(eez_sovereign == "High seas", access_fao, access)) %>%
      filter(access_fin == 1) %>%              # only where this flag has access
      left_join(reach) %>%
      filter(dist_km <= radius_km_med) %>%     # exact radius for this year
      inner_join(dplyr::select(env_yr, -any_of(c("pixel_id", env_spatial_cols))),
                 by = c("lon", "lat", "year"))

    if (nrow(full_data) == 0) {
      cat("skipping", flag, yr, "check to make sure this is right\n")
      next
    }

    ## Both stages predicted on the same rows -> plain columns, no join needed
    full_data$pred_prop <- predict(stage2_model, data = full_data, num.threads = n_threads)$predictions
    p1 <- predict(stage1_model, data = full_data, num.threads = n_threads)$predictions[, "1"]

    full_data <- full_data %>%
      mutate(pred_presence         = ifelse(is.na(p1), 0, p1),
             pred_presence_rescale = ifelse(access_fin * pred_presence > 0, 1, 0))  # any prediction > 0 = presence

    if (flag == "RAA" && yr %in% 2015:2016) {  # Azores throws no predictions for these years
      full_data <- full_data %>%
        mutate(pred_presence_rescale = ifelse(eez_sovereign == "RAA", 1, pred_presence_rescale))
    }

    full_data$pred_presence_gf <- full_data$pred_presence_rescale
    cat_keys <- c("flag_fin", "gear", "length_category")

    #### Gap-fill step 1 (by gear) -- only if some flag/gear/length combo has zero predictions
    n_preds_df <- full_data %>%
      group_by(across(all_of(cat_keys))) %>%
      summarise(n_preds = sum(pred_presence_rescale > 0), .groups = "drop")

    if (any(n_preds_df$n_preds == 0)) {

      best_lc <- n_preds_df %>%
        group_by(flag_fin, gear) %>%
        slice_max(n_preds, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        dplyr::select(flag_fin, gear, length_category)

      # max presence across length categories per cell/gear, kept only for cells where the best length category is present
      gear_fill <- full_data %>%
        group_by(lon, lat, flag_fin, gear) %>%
        summarise(max_fill = max(pred_presence_rescale), .groups = "drop") %>%
        semi_join(semi_join(full_data, best_lc, by = cat_keys),
                  by = c("lon", "lat", "flag_fin", "gear"))

      full_data <- full_data %>%
        left_join(gear_fill, by = c("lon", "lat", "flag_fin", "gear")) %>%
        left_join(n_preds_df, by = cat_keys) %>%
        mutate(pred_presence_gf = case_when(
          pred_presence_rescale == 0 & max_fill > 0 & n_preds == 0 ~ max_fill,
          TRUE ~ pred_presence_rescale)) %>%
        dplyr::select(-max_fill, -n_preds)

      #### Gap-fill step 2 (by length category) -- only if zeros remain
      n_preds_df2 <- full_data %>%
        group_by(across(all_of(cat_keys))) %>%
        summarise(n_preds = sum(pred_presence_gf > 0), .groups = "drop")

      if (any(n_preds_df2$n_preds == 0)) {

        best_gear <- n_preds_df2 %>%
          group_by(flag_fin, length_category) %>%
          filter(n_preds == max(n_preds)) %>%
          ungroup() %>%
          dplyr::select(all_of(cat_keys))

        lc_fill <- full_data %>%
          semi_join(best_gear, by = cat_keys) %>%
          group_by(lon, lat, flag_fin, length_category) %>%
          summarise(max_fill = max(pred_presence_gf), .groups = "drop")

        full_data <- full_data %>%
          left_join(lc_fill, by = c("lon", "lat", "flag_fin", "length_category")) %>%
          left_join(n_preds_df2, by = cat_keys) %>%
          mutate(pred_presence_gf = case_when(
            pred_presence_gf == 0 & max_fill > 0 & n_preds == 0 ~ max_fill,
            TRUE ~ pred_presence_gf)) %>%
          dplyr::select(-max_fill, -n_preds)
      }
    }
    
        #### Gap-fill step 3 (last resort): combos still with no presence get presence in their own EEZ
    n_preds_df3 <- full_data %>%
      group_by(across(all_of(cat_keys))) %>%
      summarise(n_preds = sum(pred_presence_gf > 0), .groups = "drop")

    still_zero <- filter(n_preds_df3, n_preds == 0)

    if (nrow(still_zero) > 0) {
      cat("gap-fill step 3 (own EEZ):", flag, yr, "-",
          paste(still_zero$gear, still_zero$length_category, collapse = "; "), "\n")

      full_data <- full_data %>%
        left_join(n_preds_df3, by = cat_keys) %>%
        mutate(pred_presence_gf = ifelse(n_preds == 0 & eez_sovereign %in% flag, 1, pred_presence_gf)) %>%
        dplyr::select(-n_preds)
    }

    ## Combine stages, rescale within each category, and allocate effort
    all_preds <- full_data %>%
      dplyr::select(lon, lat, flag_fin, gear, length_category, year, fao_id, eez_id,
                    eez_sovereign, pred_prop, pred_presence_gf) %>%
      mutate(pred_prop_final = pred_prop * pred_presence_gf) %>%
      filter(pred_prop_final > 0) %>%                       # also drops NAs
      group_by(flag_fin, gear, length_category) %>%         # year is constant here
      mutate(prop_fishing_hours_cell_predict_rescaled = pred_prop_final / sum(pred_prop_final)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      left_join(filter(hist_flag, year == yr)) %>%
      mutate(nom_active_fishing_hours = prop_fishing_hours_cell_predict_rescaled * total_nominal_fishing_hours,
             eff_active_fishing_hours = prop_fishing_hours_cell_predict_rescaled * total_effective_fishing_hours) %>%
      left_join(global_grid) %>%
      left_join(fao_lookup) %>%
      dplyr::select(pixel_id, lon, lat, year, flag_fin, gear, length_category, eez_sovereign,
                    fao_id, fao_major_fishing_area, nom_active_fishing_hours, eff_active_fishing_hours) %>%
      filter(nom_active_fishing_hours > 0) %>%
      mutate(sector = "Industrial")

    if (nrow(all_preds) == 0) {
      cat("skipping", flag, yr, "no predictions made...\n")
      next
    }
    
# test_preds <- all_preds %>%
#   dplyr::group_by(lon, lat) %>%
#   summarise(nom_active_fishing_hours = sum(nom_active_fishing_hours, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
#   ungroup() %>%
#   rast(., type = "xyz")
# 
# plot(test_preds)
# plot(log(test_preds+1)) # Cool!

    qs::qsave(all_preds, out_file)
  }

  NULL
}

parallel::stopCluster(cl)

## Report any flags that errored (e.g. missing models) without killing the whole run
errs <- Filter(function(x) inherits(x, "error"), res)
if (length(errs)) print(errs)

```

Combine all years for flag and save 
  - need to convert hours to days 
  - need to calculate nv
    -  `nv = nominal_effort / (days_at_sea*mean_engine_p)`

```{r}

days_to_hours_conversion <- qs::qread(here("data/int/hours_to_days_conversion.qs")) %>%
  rename(lon = x, lat = y) %>%
  left_join(global_grid)

nv_conversion <- qs::qread(here("data/model_features/rousseau_ind_effort_nv_conversion.qs"))


data_grid_area <- data_grid_area %>%
st_drop_geometry()

cl <- makeCluster(30) 
registerDoParallel(cl)

foreach(flag = flags_missing_fin, .packages = c("qs", "dplyr", "tidyverse", "glue", "countrycode")) %dopar% {
  # flag = "UKR"
  
  all_files_flag <- list.files(file.path(rdsi_dir, "prep/random_forest/predictions_regional/yearly/"), pattern = flag, full.names = TRUE)
  
    # Skip iteration if no files are found
  if (length(all_files_flag) == 0) next
  
  # hours / hours/day = hours * day/hours = days

  all_data_flag <- lapply(all_files_flag, qread) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    left_join(eez_lookup) %>%
    mutate(flag_country_name = countrycode(flag_fin, origin = "iso3c", destination = "country.name")) %>%
        mutate(eez_country_name = countrycode(eez_sovereign, origin = "iso3c", destination = "country.name")) %>%
    mutate(eez_country_name = ifelse(eez_sovereign == "High seas", "High seas", eez_country_name)) %>%
    dplyr::select(pixel_id, lon, lat, year, flag_fin, flag_country_name, gear, length_category, eez_sovereign, eez_country_name, fao_id, fao_major_fishing_area, nom_active_fishing_hours, eff_active_fishing_hours, sector) %>%
        left_join(nv_conversion) %>%
          mutate(nv = nom_active_fishing_hours/(days_at_sea*mean_engine_p)) %>%
    left_join(., days_to_hours_conversion) %>%
    mutate(nom_active_fishing_days = nom_active_fishing_hours/mean,
           eff_active_fishing_days = eff_active_fishing_hours/mean) %>%
    dplyr::select(-mean, -days_at_sea, -mean_engine_p, -p, -gt, -nom_active_days, -eff_active_days) %>%
        rename(flag_country_iso3c = flag_fin, eez_sovereign_iso3c = eez_sovereign, eez_sovereign_name = eez_country_name, fao_fishing_id = fao_id) %>%
    left_join(data_grid_area) %>%
    mutate(pixel_area_km2 = pixel_area_m2/1000000) %>%
    mutate(eff_days_km2 = eff_active_fishing_days/pixel_area_km2,
           nom_days_km2 = nom_active_fishing_days/pixel_area_km2,
           eff_hours_km2 = eff_active_fishing_hours/pixel_area_km2,
           nom_hours_km2 = nom_active_fishing_hours/pixel_area_km2,
           nv_km2 = nv/pixel_area_km2) # calculate hours per km2 here too
  
  qs::qsave(all_data_flag, file.path(rdsi_dir, glue("prep/random_forest/predictions_regional/model_preds_1950_2017_{flag}.qs")))
}

stopCluster(cl)



  all_files_flag <- str_before_first(str_after_last(list.files(file.path(rdsi_dir, "prep/random_forest/predictions_regional/"), pattern = ".qs", full.names = TRUE), "_"), "\\.qs")
  
  setdiff(flags_missing, all_files_flag) # 0 - good
```
